# `abs`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the absolute value of the numeric or interval value.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
abs(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- abs, example 1
> SELECT abs(-1);
1
```

```sql
-- abs, example 2
> SELECT abs(INTERVAL -'1-1' YEAR TO MONTH);
1-1
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.2.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
